meta.phase: SC-0 — Claim audit, scope lock, and design contract
meta.purpose: Machine-readable admission record for every biological or explanatory object proposed by the showcase plan. This file authorizes claims and presentation scope; it contains no authoritative biological coordinates.

schema_migration.reason: SC-19 replaces a whole-file byte pin with stable per-claim support bindings and semantic invariants.

scope_lock.educational_narrative: Broadly applicable titin concepts explained through an explicitly scoped reference-sequence model.
scope_lock.default_structural_context: resting reference unless the sarcomere-length state is explicitly shown
scope_lock.cross_tissue_rule: A context source from another tissue may document a limitation or conserved relationship, but it cannot supply authoritative coordinates unless transfer is independently established and recorded.
scope_lock.mechanics_rule: Sarcomere length and biochemical activation remain independent; the showcase does not add a regulatory or active-contraction solver.

admission_decisions.zdisc: ADMIT a scoped close-up based on the heterogeneous thin-form network measured in fast mouse psoas. Do not present a regular small-square or basketweave lattice as universal.
admission_decisions.mband: REPLACE the opaque 160 nm M-line slab in SC-3. Distinguish the head-free bare zone, the sarcomere midpoint, and protein crosslink context. Do not render an M1 density from the 2023 averaged map.
admission_decisions.mybpc: ADMIT_SCHEMATIC as an optional, off-by-default skeletal C-zone context layer. Skeletal evidence supports presence and approximate periodic context, not exact human coordinates, a universal rigid bridge, or a direct titin contact.
admission_decisions.thin_filament_regulation: DEFER. Troponin/tropomyosin regulation is valid biology but is not necessary to explain titin and would consume the showcase attention budget.
admission_decisions.n2a_interaction_hub: ADMIT as an Evidence-mode expert card tied to the existing N2A region. Do not add partner coordinates.
admission_decisions.titin_kinase: ADMIT the existing domain and a qualified Evidence-mode card. Do not present a single activation or mechanosensing mechanism as settled.
admission_decisions.length_dependent_activation: ADMIT as proposed text-only expert context. Do not encode it as active mechanics or couple it to sarcomere length.

visual_grammar.palette_status: Candidate only until contrast, common color-vision, grayscale, and projector tests pass.
visual_grammar.identity_channel: Protein identity uses hue and labeling.
visual_grammar.selection_channel: Selection uses a same-family rim, outline, or luminance change and never replaces the identity hue.
visual_grammar.evidence_channel: Evidence uses a text badge plus line/opacity treatment; evidence is never encoded by color alone.
visual_grammar.schematic_channel: Schematic presentation uses an explicit SCHEMATIC badge and, where legible, a dash or halo treatment.
visual_grammar.unknown_channel: Unknown extent is omitted or displayed as a labeled uncertainty envelope, never filled in by decorative geometry.
visual_grammar.supplied_illustration_policy: The user-supplied illustrations and Wikipedia image are composition references only. Product geometry must be procedurally redrawn from admitted claims and cite the underlying source record.

attention_budget.detail_rule: Z-disc, M-band, MyBP-C, and molecular-repeat detail appear only in their relevant close-up or expert chapter.
attention_budget.occlusion_rule: Hide a lower-priority label before allowing overlap, detachment from its anchor, or obstruction of the highlighted titin path.
attention_budget.motion_rule: One transition communicates one change; reduced-motion mode jumps to the identical scientific state.

objects.name: Reference scope and state badge
objects.claim: The active visualization uses the citation-reviewed human TTN reference sequence Q8WZ42-1 at the explicitly named structural state without assigning a tissue-specific construct.
objects.scope: Homo sapiens Q8WZ42-1 reference sequence; no tissue-specific claim; active state shown live

sources.transfer_limit: None beyond the explicit reference label.
The badge reports the model state; it does not convert a modeled state into an observation.

objects.render_encoding: Persistent DOM badge above the stage; abbreviated in Guided mode and expandable in Evidence mode.

objects.name: Continuous Z-disc-to-M-band titin path
objects.claim: One titin polypeptide runs continuously through a half-sarcomere from its Z-disc N terminus to its M-band C terminus.
objects.scope: Human Q8WZ42 topology in the retained half-sarcomere model

sources.role: in-sarcomere epitope mapping from Z-line toward M-line
sources.transfer_limit: The study constrains longitudinal topology, not a resolved atom-by-atom path.
Sequence order does not resolve transverse placement.

objects.render_encoding: A render-only continuity trace follows the exact existing backbone points and is visually subordinate to the domain geometry.
not_claimed: known transverse azimuth along the entire chain
uniform spring behavior along the chain

objects.name: I-band spring regions and A-band scaffold
objects.claim: Titin is regionally heterogeneous: elastic I-band segments lie in series with an A-band segment integrated with the thick filament and a terminal M-region.
objects.scope: Human Q8WZ42 region order; current N2A-containing model

sources.transfer_limit: Sequence annotations do not determine every 3D conformation.

sources.role: axial alignment of A-band titin with the thick filament
sources.transfer_limit: Supports axial organization, not a universal exact azimuth.

objects.render_encoding: Titin-family colors distinguish regions; the A-band remains positionally bound while the I-band changes length.
not_claimed: a single elastic constant for all regions

objects.name: Regional I-band extension
objects.claim: Across the modeled range, tandem-Ig chains primarily straighten while disordered spring regions extend; ordinary length change does not require widespread folded-domain unfolding.
objects.scope: Current modeled Q8WZ42 length states; passive geometry, not activation

sources.role: in-situ folded-Ig and unfolded-PEVK extension behavior
sources.transfer_limit: Supports the qualitative physiological mechanism, not this model's exact per-region nanometer partition.
Computed model output is not a measured molecular trajectory.

objects.render_encoding: Synchronized 3D state and region-extension chart; folded proxies remain rigid while spacing/linkers and disordered paths change.

objects.name: Live Z-disc, I-band, A-band, C-zone, bare-zone, and M-band brackets
objects.claim: The named sarcomere regions occupy distinct axial intervals, and their live boundaries must follow the same geometry used by the scene.
objects.scope: Current half-sarcomere geometry at the selected sarcomere length

sources.transfer_limit: Some intervals combine measured dimensions with model-derived state positions; each tooltip must report the weakest applicable evidence.
State interpolation is a model, not an observed trajectory.

objects.render_encoding: Screen-space brackets computed from live scene landmarks; the bare-zone and M-band labels remain separate.
not_claimed: that a bracket is a molecular structure
that the bare zone and M-band are synonyms
that all band boundaries are sharp molecular interfaces

objects.name: Scoped Z-disc actin/α-actinin network
objects.claim: Antiparallel actin filaments from adjacent sarcomeres interdigitate in the Z-disc and are crosslinked by α-actinin in a heterogeneous local network.
objects.scope: Fast mouse psoas thin-form Z-disc, interpreted as a lower-strain isolated-myofibril state; topology-only context for the human reference

sources.role: native skeletal Z-disc topology and α-actinin network
sources.transfer_limit: Mouse fast-psoas local topology is not an exact human lattice or a universal activation state.

objects.render_encoding: Zoom-gated, slightly irregular local network with opposing actin polarity; no infinite regular lattice tile.

objects.name: α-Actinin crosslink doublets
objects.claim: The selected fast-psoas thin-form reconstruction contains α-actinin crosslink doublets separated by approximately 6 nm, with heterogeneous larger spacings.
objects.scope: Fast mouse psoas thin-form Z-disc only

sources.transfer_limit: The doublets were not regular and may differ across Z-disc forms or muscle types.

objects.render_encoding: A few explicitly scoped doublets appear only at a resolvable Z-disc close-up; spacing is generated from the admitted record, not by eye.
not_claimed: regular repetition across the entire Z-disc
presence in every muscle type or state

objects.name: Titin Z1Z2–telethonin sandwich
objects.claim: Telethonin forms a palindromic 2:1 sandwich with two antiparallel titin Z1Z2 N-terminal fragments.
objects.scope: Experimentally resolved human titin fragment complex; mapped topologically into the retained Z-disc close-up

sources.transfer_limit: The isolated complex resolves binding topology, not its complete in-situ lateral route or surrounding Z-disc lattice.

objects.render_encoding: Two opposing Z1Z2 proxy chains meet one labeled telethonin proxy; the topology is visually distinct from actin crosslinks.
not_claimed: a decorative cap on one titin chain
a resolved full in-situ titin route

objects.name: Universal regular Z-disc lattice
objects.claim: No single regular small-square, basketweave, or zigzag icon is admitted as the universal Z-disc arrangement.
objects.scope: All muscle types and structural states

sources.role: documents heterogeneous Z-disc forms and state interpretation limits
sources.transfer_limit: The study supports omission of a universal motif; it does not establish one replacement motif for all tissues.
A rat-cardiac small-square structure cannot be promoted to a generic reference-sequence icon.

objects.render_encoding: No geometry; Evidence mode states why the universal icon is omitted.
not_claimed: that the omitted motif is biologically absent
that Z-disc topology is completely unknown

objects.name: Central head-free bare zone
objects.claim: The bare zone is a central region of the bipolar thick filament characterized by absence of myosin heads, not a solid protein slab.
objects.scope: Relaxed mammalian skeletal thick-filament context; current modeled bare-zone interval

sources.transfer_limit: Supports skeletal thick-filament organization; the current interval remains the project's sourced specification.
The 160 nm value must be labeled bare-zone width and not reused as M-band protein width.

objects.render_encoding: Communicate the region through myosin-head absence, a subtle bracket, and optional low-opacity presentation tint.
not_claimed: a complete molecular description of the bare zone

objects.name: M-band midpoint and crosslink context
objects.claim: The M-band is protein crosslinking and integration architecture near the sarcomere center, where thick filaments and titin from opposing half-sarcomeres meet.
objects.scope: Generic skeletal sarcomere relationship; exact crosslink positions unresolved in the retained model

sources.role: directly observes pleomorphic crosslinking densities in the mouse-psoas rigor M-band without assigning individual protein identities
sources.transfer_limit: Supports the presence of heterogeneous skeletal M-band crosslinking density, not the identity or exact position of a particular protein.

sources.role: primary immunoelectron localization of titin, myomesin, and M-protein across the skeletal M-band
sources.transfer_limit: Establishes component relationships and relative M-band organization in vertebrate skeletal muscle; no line coordinate is transferred to the retained human reference.
The isolated complex does not resolve the complete in-situ M-band network.

objects.render_encoding: A narrow midpoint reference plus sparse, individually labeled schematic crosslinks; mirrored titin paths remain visible through the center.

objects.name: M1 density
objects.claim: The sarcomere midpoint may be labeled as a coordinate reference, but no density in this showcase is identified as M1 from the 2023 averaged reconstruction.
objects.scope: Limitation from relaxed mouse cardiac M-band reconstruction; no coordinate transfer

sources.role: reports M1 absent from the averaged reconstruction
sources.transfer_limit: The cardiac reconstruction is used only to prevent overclaiming; it supplies no skeletal coordinate.

objects.name: Optional skeletal MyBP-C C-zone context
objects.claim: Skeletal MyBP-C is an accessory C-zone protein associated with the thick filament in an approximately 43 nm periodic context and can influence lattice and myosin-head regulation.
objects.scope: Fast MyBP-C in permeabilized mouse psoas; optional context for the human Q8WZ42-1 reference-sequence model

sources.role: fast skeletal MyBP-C C-zone and periodic context
sources.transfer_limit: Supports optional skeletal context, not exact human coordinates, domain path, stripe register, reach, or binding pose.

objects.render_encoding: Sparse yellow schematic markers or flexible paths in the C-zone, off by default and subordinate to titin; exact path carries a SCHEMATIC badge.
not_claimed: three exact molecules at every human titin superrepeat

objects.name: Orthographic myofilament lattice comparison
objects.claim: The current model places thick and thin filaments in a hexagonal lattice and predicts decreasing d10 as sarcomere length increases under its declared constant-volume idealization.
objects.scope: Current modeled lattice; primary comparison restricted to the declared 2000–2400 nm working band

sources.role: measured d10 response with sarcomere length
sources.transfer_limit: Rat myocardium calibrates context; it is not direct geometry for the scope-ledger construct.
Constant-volume scaling is an idealized model, not active time-resolved lattice mechanics.

objects.render_encoding: Same-scale orthographic cross-sections derived from existing lattice sites, with a live d10 dimension line and visible MODELED caveat.
not_claimed: directly measured d10 for the scope-ledger construct

global_negative_controls: Reject any cardiac titin or alternative-isoform scene mode.
Reject any exact cardiac cMyBP-C coordinate in the reference-sequence model.
Reject any MyBP-C path promoted above SCHEMATIC placement evidence.
Reject any M1 density sourced only from the 2023 averaged M-band reconstruction.
Reject any 160 nm M-line protein slab or synonymization of M-band and bare zone.
Reject any Z-disc depiction with one titin chain in the 2:1 telethonin sandwich.
Reject any universal regular Z-disc lattice claim.
Reject any automatic coupling of short sarcomere length to biochemical activation.
Reject any source figure copied without a separately recorded compatible license.
Reject any presentation layer that moves a biological anchor or strengthens evidence.
